data.content_ref: inline:The isolated artifact 120dd644125e DEPENDS ON SRC_005's OOD-probe requirement: any claim of panel+checklist superiority within a single evaluation inherits the requirement for out-of-distribution probes to distinguish genuine comprehension from checklist overfit. The dependence holds because the causal mechanism (cue-omission prevention + error cancellation) predicts robust performance on OOD items, while the competing anchoring-artifact hypothesis predicts a sharp drop. The dependence is REFUTED IF the task class is closed (all cases covered by the checklist, making OOD probes impossible) and the panel still fails on held-out in-distribution items, which would make the OOD probe unnecessary and the dependence spurious; or if the expert also fails on OOD probes, making the divergence uninformative as a discriminator between the two mechanisms.
